richtext.heading: Up and Running in Minutes
richtext.lead: Install the DXP AI SDK, initialize your client, and fetch personalized content with just a few lines of code.
richtext.name: Richtext
richtext.sidebarText:
Our developer support team is available Monday–Friday, 9am–6pm IST. Enterprise customers get 24/7 dedicated developer support.

Join our Developer Community on Slack — 2,000+ active developers sharing tips, integrations, and custom connectors.
richtext.text:
1. Install the SDK

Install the official DXP AI SDK via npm:

npm install @dxpai/sdk

2. Initialize the Client

Create a client instance with your API key and region:

import DXPAIClient from '@dxpai/sdk';
const client = new DXPAIClient({ apiKey: 'YOUR_API_KEY', region: 'ap-south-1' });

3. Fetch Personalized Content

Retrieve content with ZensAI personalization applied:

const content = await client.content.get({ path: '/home', userId: currentUser.id, context: { device: 'mobile', segment: 'enterprise' } });

4. Publish an Event

Track user interactions to feed the ZensAI personalization engine:

await client.events.track({ type: 'content.viewed', contentId: content.id, userId: currentUser.id });
